subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR remain blocked until redacted real embedded-agent proof is added, or may maintainers accept the current test/CI evidence plus private validation for the internal-handoff drop and `sessions_send` preservation paths?
rationale: External PR proof is currently tests and CI only, and the patch changes session-state prompt repair semantics for six internal source tools; automation cannot decide whether private maintainer proof is enough.

options.title: Require runtime proof before merge
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording from a real embedded-agent run that shows internal handoff text is dropped and `sessions_send` content is still preserved.

options.title: Accept private maintainer proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly own the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Pause for repair-shape choice
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers compare it with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 and choose the canonical repair strategy.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording from a real embedded-agent run that shows internal handoff text is dropped and `sessions_send` content is still preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to this person for the original queued-user prompt preservation behavior and recent helper ownership signals.
